story_idea: A maintenance engineer boards a dead orbital relay and races to restore a distress signal from a trapped survivor capsule.
style: Grounded near-future science fiction, cold industrial realism, restrained blue and amber lighting, realistic materials, cinematic contrast.
subject: Mara remains the same maintenance engineer in the same orange pressure suit throughout all six scenes.

actors.name: Mara
actors.visual_description: A woman in her early thirties with a lean face, short black hair, tired brown eyes, and a weathered orange pressure suit with a compact wrist terminal.
